title: Crispy Keto Sweet Potato Fritters
description: Crispy fritters made with sweet potatoes and a hint of indulgence. A great keto alternative to traditional fritters.
instructions: Grate the sweet potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, mix together the grated sweet potatoes, indulgent cheese, syrian spice blend, egg, salt, and black pepper.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Note: You can also pan-fry the fritters in a skillet with a small amount of oil if you prefer a crisper exterior.
